    Sincere directing modules on trees #

    • Directed paths of a sincere directing module split into two parts of bounded length (run_bound), by Vossieck's lemma.
    • If a point t separates two orthogonal convex parts, then a summand of the truncation to one of the parts is a clean line from t (line_of_cut).
